cURL Command Builder

Fill in method, URL, headers, and body to get a copy-paste curl command with safe shell quoting.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose the HTTP method and enter the URL.
  2. Add headers and a request body as needed.
  3. Click Build — copy the curl command.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are values quoted?

Single quotes are used; embedded single quotes are escaped the POSIX way ('\'').

Can I add multiple headers?

Yes — rows with an empty name are skipped, and --data is only added when a body exists.

Does it support following redirects?

Yes — tick the option and -L is added.

What about special characters in values?

Paste the values as-is; the builder quotes everything safely.
